query:
INSERT INTO artifact_payloads (sha256, byte_len, body, ref_count)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 1)
            ON CONFLICT (sha256) DO UPDATE SET
                ref_count = artifact_payloads.ref_count + 1,
                last_seen_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            RETURNING (xmax = 0) as "created!"
